title: Texturing Layer 3 — stripes via vertex-color band painting + small follow-ups
notes: Layer 3 in the original S109 FEAT-PROCEDURAL-TEXTURING proposal had three sub-styles: solid (default), stripes, spots. Spots need true shader-side procedural noise (high subdivision is impractical), so they stay deferred for a future shader-injection story.
Stripes are tractable via vertex-color band painting: bump heightSegments and paint alternating Y-bands with the accent colour. Same cheap pattern that the panel-seams + decals layers use.

stories.title: Procedural texturing Layer 3 (stripes only) — vertex-color band painting
stories.summary:
Add `texturing.pattern: { style: 'solid' | 'stripes', scale: number }` to CharacterRecipe. When `style === 'stripes'`, the painter bumps the affected box's heightSegments to ~4 (giving 5 vertex rows in Y) and paints alternating rows with palette.accent on top of the base + panelSeams + decal passes. Scale controls how many bands appear (clamped to 2–6 inclusive).

Spots are out of scope for this story — they need either much higher subdivision (impractical) or shader-side noise (separate story). Solid is the default and is a NO-OP (current behaviour).

Approach lives entirely in bomber-parts.ts (applyStripes helper called by applyTexturing). Bench UI gains a 3-state dropdown (solid / stripes) + a scale slider. Recipe codec round-trips the pattern block.
verification: acceptance: Procedural texturing Layer 3 — stripes shipped. CharacterRecipe gains optional texturing.pattern: { style: 'solid'|'stripes', scale: 2..6 } (default solid = no-op). When style==='stripes', the part-builder bumps the box heightSegments to scale × 2 and applyStripes paints alternating Y-bands with palette.accent. Skips top + bottom rim rows so the panelSeams darken stays; defers to decals (decals override stripes at their anchor verts). Spots are explicitly out of scope — they need shader-side noise that doesn't fit vertex-color painting. Bench UI gains pattern dropdown + scale slider. Recipe codec round-trips the pattern block.

examples/procbomber-bench/src/generators/bomber-parts.ts: PATTERN_STYLES, PatternStyle, BomberPattern, STRIPE_SCALE_RANGE, heightSegmentsFor(), applyStripes(), buildBoxLike accepts heightSegments param
examples/procbomber-bench/src/character-recipe.ts: pattern in BomberTexturing, resolveTexturing default, validator accepts the block
examples/procbomber-bench/src/bench-state.ts + bench-ui.ts + recipe-url.ts: patternStyle + patternScale state, dropdown + slider UI, recipe sync
+7 unit tests covering solid (no-op), stripes paint accent, geometry vert count bumps with stripes, scale ratio, scale clamping, deterministic output, rim rows untouched
Full suite 1307/1307. Spots deferred — explicit follow-up needed for shader-side procedural noise.
